verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a built-in LLM chat that can link to sessions and read terminal contents. It offers context-aware help, runs commands on your behalf, and explains output with annotations, enabled through a first-party AI plugin (gh-6, docs-15, docs-50). A hands-on report confirms it generated a working awk command from piped input much faster than searching (comm-5). Community notes say it needs your own API key and sends nothing until you ask a question (comm-3, comm-9). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the insight and annotation features, a built-in model (it relies on a separately installed plugin and a user-supplied API key), and independent corroboration of output-explanation quality beyond a single command-generation anecdote.
